title: What if the dinosaur asteroid hit today? ☄️
subject: asteroid
description:
Where would you hide if it hit tomorrow? 👇

What would happen if the Chicxulub asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs hit Earth today? A mile-high tsunami, a sky that rains hot rock, and years without sunlight. Some details, like global wildfires, are still debated by scientists.

Sources: AGU (Range et al. 2022, AGU Advances, global tsunami simulation with NOAA PMEL & University of Michigan), AGU press release on Purdue study, J. Geophys. Res. Biogeosciences (July 2026), Smithsonian Magazine

scenes.text: A 6-mile rock slams into the Gulf of Mexico.
It throws up a wave over a mile high, and the tsunami crosses every ocean.
But here's the strange part. The deadliest thing may fall from the sky.
Scientists think molten rock drops rained down, and a 2026 study says dust trapped their heat until forests burst into flames.
Then dust blocks the Sun for years. Last time, about 75 percent of species vanished.
